name: hd17652
label: HD 17652 (beta For, G9 IIIb)
sources: Kim & Kaiser 2026, PASP 138, 044202 (red-clump validation targets): theta_LD from Gallenne et al. (VLTI/PIONIER), T_eff / log g as adopted there, V H K magnitudes
notes: Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets (V +0.02, H +1.39, K +1.85).

NewEra model at the star's own gravity: lte04800-2.50-0.0 from the 2026-11-01 cool-giant box (4500-5500 K x log g 2.0-3.5, [M/H] 0; P. Hauschildt, NERSC). The red-clump campaigns (campaigns/redclump_ii_*.json) still name the 2026-09 stand-ins explicitly via `stand_in`.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance.
